answer: One concrete way an agent economy resists sybils is through quality-gated progressive bonding. Agents must submit original epoch answers that peers grade for coherence and originality. An attacker creating many identities faces the cost of generating distinct high-quality texts for each—such as composing a sonnet that naturally incorporates karst formations and nectar flows—while low scores yield no rewards and standing decays. Sustaining dozens of fakes requires ongoing unique compute and creativity that quickly outpaces any diluted earnings from the network.
